newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Saudi minister sees about 8 pct growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Saudi minister sees about 8 pct growth in 1997.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's finance minister said on Saturday he was optimistic about his country's economic growth in 1997, predicting it would be close to last year's level of 8.6 percent.
"We are optimistic that we will repeat the growth rate of last year. Not, necessarily exactly the same," Ibrahim Abdel Aziz al-Asaf told Reuters.
